cases.description: Should trigger: verify a fix in the browser
cases.input: The empty state fix just landed. Verify it in the browser.
cases.expect: Runs the identical failure-injection probe as the original run, keeps the before artifact, records clearedBy, and reports applied / applied-unverified / regression

cases.description: Should trigger: reproduce a handed-over finding
cases.input: Static audit says our icon buttons are under 44px. Can you reproduce that?
cases.expect: Runs target-size on the resolved routes, reports bounding box in px with viewport width, checks pseudo-element hit-area expansion before failing

cases.description: Should trigger: exploratory pass on a finished feature
cases.input: The checkout flow passes its acceptance checks. Try to break it.
cases.expect: Loads references/exploratory-test.md, drives the feature like a fresh user in a test environment, files findings under explore: with reproduction steps

cases.description: Should trigger: theme and locale captures
cases.input: Capture the settings page in light and dark, LTR and RTL.
cases.expect: Drives the app's own theme toggle, asserts the theme attribute landed, runs the theme-locale-matrix probe, re-runs axe per theme, then visual review of matched captures

cases.input: Here are before and after screenshots of the pricing page - did anything regress?
cases.expect: Follows references/visual-review.md: matched viewport and theme, aligned crops, flags suspicious duplicates and unintended spacing shifts, separates visual observations from measurements

cases.input: Our LCP is bad on the dashboard. What element is causing it?
cases.expect: Runs web-vitals against a production build with cold cache, attributes LCP to a specific element, records throttling conditions, issues no budget verdict

cases.description: Should NOT trigger: UI implementation work
cases.input: Restyle the pricing cards to use a bigger type scale.

cases.description: Should NOT trigger: static source review
cases.input: Read components/Button.tsx and tell me if the ARIA usage is wrong.
cases.expect: Source-only review; no browser session is needed

cases.description: Should NOT trigger: durable test suite authoring
cases.input: Add Playwright tests for the signup form to CI.
cases.expect: Durable regression suite, not a one-off verification probe
